note: The NPC types of this pack, from preforged's gw-npcs 1 catalog. A definition id is local to its map there, so each row's definition_index is pack-wide and its id is npc-<map>-<definition>.

fields.id: The pack key a placement names. Never sent; the row's definition_index is what the client keys its NPC table by.
fields.definition_index: 0x0056/0x0057 field 1 and the low bits of the create's model word: the client's NPC table index, unique across this pack.
fields.h000a: 0x0056 field 3 (body offset 0x0A): 0 in every captured row; unnamed.
fields.visual: 0x0056 field 4: the visual word; its top byte is the scale in percent.
fields.h0012: 0x0056 field 5 (body offset 0x12): 0 in every captured row; unnamed.
fields.name: 0x0056's name: encoded-string UTF-16 units, 1 to 8.
fields.model_files: 0x0057's model files, 0 to 8; empty sends no 0x0057.
fields.h000b: The create's byte at body offset 0x0B: 9 for a person, 8 for an animal in the capture.
fields.speed: The create's speed, in units per second. 220 is cmonmeow's NPC value.
fields.team: The create's team dword as the client's four-character code.
